verdict: Random-pick check (200 runs each) — slots: no real gain. 1% / 7 slots (Se8a1c516) has a random median of 15.5% against 16.4% for S44984096 and beats it in only 22% of pairings; 1.5% / 7 slots (Se4840bfe) 16.4%, a coin flip (52%), with a deeper drawdown tail (to −34%). The 18.1% single result was a lucky path. The 6- and 8-slot neighbours are no better. Keep 10 slots at 1%.

Supertrend(14, 3) survives, modestly. Random median 17.2% (5th–95th 15.6–18.5%) against 16.4%, with a shallower median drawdown (−25.2% vs −26.9%) and CAGR/DD 0.68 vs 0.61; it beats S44984096 in 72% of pairings. Its neighbour (12, 3) also helps (16.8%, 62%). But the multiplier is sensitive: (14, 2.5) drops to 14.3% and (10, 4) was worse on its single path. A longer ATR period helps; the multiplier should stay at 3.
No combination tested: only the Supertrend change survived the check, so there is nothing to combine with.
2% risk with 5 slots (Sdab570f4): 16.0% / −26.2%, against 15.9% / −24.2% for S44984096: about the same return with a deeper drawdown. With the 20% entry cap most 2% positions are capped anyway.
Idle-cash interest is essential: without the liquid fund (S7b03d65f) CAGR falls from 15.9% to 12.4%. About 3.5 points a year come from parking idle cash.
Zerodha costs add about 1.9 points (Sc8f6dfe7: 17.8% / −23.9%): a real gain from how you trade, not a fitted rule.

Liquidity floor: only stocks trading ₹5 crore+ a day: 10.8%; ₹10 crore+: 8.4%. The floor is nominal (not inflation-scaled) and removes most mid caps before about 2010; for a ₹10–20 lakh account liquidity is not a constraint, but returns would shrink for a much larger account.
Ranking same-day signals by 6-month relative strength (Sd7cc0575): 15.6% / −26.4%, no better than tightest stop.

Bottom line: keep 1% risk and 10 slots; trade through a zero-brokerage broker and keep idle cash in a liquid fund. Supertrend(14, 3) (Sa1f19d11) is a candidate upgrade worth about +0.8 points a year with a slightly smaller drawdown; adopting it is a judgement call, since it rests on one parameter that has been shown sensitive to its multiplier.
